interactions.label: Study the map
interactions.text: Two places are linked: this crossing and a quiet archive. The links are part of the package; Python decides which exits are available from the current scene.

entities.name: Unlit Lantern
entities.description: A brass lantern waiting for a story. Inspecting it changes this preview's inspection state; it does not add an item to a player's inventory.

entities.name: Blank Folio
entities.description: A place for the next packet. Source references will retain the file path, line range, and hash of the material that informed it.

interactions.label: Read the margin
interactions.text: Meaning is supplied by the author or compiler. The engine validates the resulting structure, preserves its provenance, and renders only the current scene.

entities.name: Plain Longsword

scenes.title: The Unwritten Crossing
scenes.description:
A narrow bridge rests beneath a sky of pale stars. Beyond it, an archive waits to be filled.

This is a non-canon demonstration: inspect the character and item, then follow the path to another scene.

scenes.title: The Quiet Archive
scenes.description:
Shelves disappear into a soft silver haze. On the only occupied desk lies a folio.

Refresh the page or return later: the engine will remember which scene this preview reached.
